title: PVT
paper_title: Pyramid Vision Transformer: A Versatile Backbone for Dense Prediction without Convolutions
core_mech: 以逐级降低 token 分辨率的 Transformer pyramid 和 spatial-reduction attention 提供多尺度 dense-prediction backbone。
core_mech_en: Constructs a progressive four-stage token pyramid using Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) to compress K/V resolution before attention.
output_desc: 四级多尺度 Transformer 特征或分类/密集预测输出
output_en: Four-stage multi-scale feature pyramid (1/4 to 1/32 stride) for detection and segmentation

source.title: PVT
notes: Repository default branch is v2, while the Atlas paper is PVT v1. Use the matching original PVT architecture; PVTv2 is not interchangeable.

adapter.name: Pyramid Vision Transformer / PVT
adapter.mechanism: Authors' PVT v1 class: four pyramid stages, spatial-reduction attention and last-stage class token.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
CPU dimensions differ from the paper's training preset; see the explicit configuration.
